result.summary: Removes the `MAX_BIP125_RBF_SEQUENCE` constant from the functional test framework and eliminates its usage across wallet and non-wallet functional tests. Tests that previously used the constant to ensure non-final sequence numbers now use `MAX_SEQUENCE_NONFINAL` or default sequences. The constant is scoped strictly to `wallet_deprecated_rbf.py` to maintain coverage for deprecated BIP 125 RPC behavior until eventual removal.
result.problem: Functional tests throughout the test suite unnecessarily rely on BIP 125 opt-in sequence numbers even when BIP 125 signaling is irrelevant to the scenario under test, conflicting with ongoing efforts to deprecate and remove BIP 125 signaling logic from the codebase.
evidence: Author description: 'Partially fixes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/32661. This is in line with the removal and deprecation of BIP 125 RBF signalling from the codebase.'
Commit 8e8765e46d: 'Remove the usage in all the tests where used except the ones where the sequence is set to unique values to avoid creating duplicate transactions simultaneously.'
result.scope_notes: The PR branch currently includes 11 commits imported directly from prerequisite PR #35433 (deprecating the `replaceable` RPC argument and altering wallet defaults). Only the final two commits represent the scope of this PR.
result.card: Removes references to the MAX_BIP125_RBF_SEQUENCE constant from functional tests and the shared test framework, switching to MAX_SEQUENCE_NONFINAL or default values. This refactor aligns test suite conventions with the broader deprecation and eventual removal of BIP 125 opt-in RBF signaling across Bitcoin Core (partially addressing #32661). It depends on #35433, which deprecates the replaceable RPC arguments, and bundles those commits while in draft.
